issues.display_title: Issue #2669: Integrate API Place Detail Contributor
issues.main_description_html:
Integrate the Place Detail — Contributors API into the new design (place-detail Contributors tab). Wire into src/api/places.ts behind the store status/error seam (mock → live).

API

  • Postman: https://documenter.getpostman.com/view/26723813/2sBXwqsBHS#ba73aa6c-8759-47f0-a69d-50f5d37120de
  • GET /places/detail/contributors/:location_group_slug
  • example: {{base_url}}/places/detail/contributors/BAGB282c8c4c6a-lg20260605104956-bbb737a0d53d?limit=1&page=2
  • spec: GoThruMedia/panorra-api-go#388

Params

  • limit
  • page
  • include

Allowed include filters

  • avatar
  • fullname
  • username
  • total_posts
  • total_views
  • top_contributor
  • is_following

Notes

  • typed model/DTO; cursor/page pagination; loading / empty / error states

Demo by Developer

WhatsApp.Video.2026-06-22.at.16.21.19.1.mp4

QA Summary — Bug Found

Selecting the Contributor tab in Place Detail triggers a React Native runtime exception and the contributor content cannot render.

Item Result
Environment Development; Samsung SM-A235F; Panorra v1.9.25
Test data Hospital Helipad (real Place Detail data)
Actual result App fails to render the Contributor tab after its data begins rendering
Expected result Contributor list renders with profile, metrics, and follow state
Verdict Bug Found

Reproduction

  1. Open Places near you from Home.
  2. Select Hospital Helipad.
  3. Select the Contributor tab.
  4. Wait for contributor data to render.

Technical finding

Evidence Result
Runtime log Couldn't find a navigation object. Is your component inside NavigationContainer?
Failing component ContributorRow
Source review ContributorRow calls useNavigation() while rendered through the Place Detail bottom-sheet flow
Source src/pages/place-detail/_components/tabs/ContributorsTab.tsx

Test methods

Method Result
Black-box Reproduced on a physical Android device using real Development data
Gray-box Device log identifies the failing ContributorRow render path
White-box Source trace confirms the navigation-context dependency in the failing row
Confusion matrix Not applicable: this is a navigation/rendering integration flow, not a classification scenario

Evidence

Area Result Evidence
Verdict Passed Confirmed by QA real-device validation and tester confirmation.
Environment Dev / real Android Samsung SM-A235F, Panorra 1.9.25; notifications disabled during recording.
Suggest success Passed Searching tor displayed real place suggestions.
Selection flow Passed Selecting Conservatory CANOPEE Chateaudun opened its matching Place Detail.
Empty state Passed Searching zzzqaplaceabsent displayed No places found - try another spelling.
Error state Code reviewed Error state is rendered when the suggestion request fails; no live endpoint failure was induced against Dev.
Restart Passed Relaunch returned to Home and the place-search flow remained available.

Method Coverage Result
Black box Real-device search, suggestion selection, Place Detail navigation, and empty-result behaviour Passed
Gray box Verified UI states against the Home search store and debounce flow Passed

Confusion matrix Not applicable; place suggestion is retrieval/search, not a classification feature N/A

Code Review

File Review result
src/api/places.ts Calls GET /places/suggest and maps valid place suggestion records.
src/pages/home/hooks/use-debounced-place-search.ts Debounces input and requests suggestions after one or more characters.
src/pages/home/store/HomeStore.ts Handles loading, success, stale/aborted requests, and error state.

Real-device screenshot and 17.9-second clean recording were captured locally during the validated Dev flow. No device notifications were shown in the evidence area.

No coding bug found. The Suggest Place List integration works with real Dev data and the current mobile UI.

issues.display_title: Issue #2668: Integrate API Place Detail Post
issues.main_description_html:
Integrate the Place Detail — Posts API into the new design (place-detail Posts tab). Wire into src/api/places.ts behind the store status/error seam (mock → live).

API

  • Postman: https://documenter.getpostman.com/view/26723813/2sBXwqsBHS#9c8feda5-fb96-4773-bad6-1af264553530
  • GET /places/detail/posts/:location_group_slug
  • example: {{base_url}}/places/detail/posts/BAGB282c8c4c6a-lg20260605104956-bbb737a0d53d?limit=2&page=1
  • spec: GoThruMedia/panorra-api-go#393

Params

  • limit
  • page
  • include
  • search (optional — by description or location_name)
  • sort (nearest, most_posts, latest_post)
  • lat (if sort by nearest)
  • lng (if sort by nearest)

Allowed include filters

  • slug
  • thumbnail
  • description
  • created_at
  • post_type
  • animation
  • little_planet
  • user
  • total_views
  • total_likes
  • total_comments
  • potd
  • distance_km (for nearest)

Sub-tasks

  • Can search by description or location name
  • Can sort by nearest, most posts, or latest post

Notes
